claims: April 15, 2026 is the deadline for most Americans to file their 2025 federal income tax returns.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline for most Americans to pay any taxes owed.
Tax returns must be postmarked or electronically submitted by April 15, 2026.
IRS Form 4868 provides an automatic six-month extension.
The six-month extension shifts the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
Taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026.
Filing an extension does not provide more time to pay taxes owed.
Missing the deadline without an extension can result in penalties of 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
Residents of Maine and Massachusetts have until April 17, 2026, to file due to the Patriots' Day holiday.
